title: Addition of run times
statement: Let $P$ be a register program, let $\mathcal O$ be an oracle assigning a Boolean answer to each decider and Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration. For all natural numbers $a,b$, running the program for $a+b$ steps from $c$ gives the same configuration as running it for $a$ steps from $c$ and then for $b$ more steps.
